turns.text: what is actually inside a consent artefact when I fetch it

must_contain: It lists the care contexts approved, the health information types permitted and the date range the records may fall in.
It gives the date by which you must erase the data, dataEraseAt.
It names the HIP and the HIU and carries a signature.
notes: Defines the artefact by what an HIU receives, which bounds the health information request that follows. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m3-consent-fetch.md, 'It lists: the care contexts approved; the health information types permitted; the date range, and the date to erase the data; the [HIP] and [HIU], and a signature'; catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m3-on-consent-fetch.md, 'It carries the artefact's `status`, its detail and its `signature`. The detail says which care contexts, health information types and dates you may request, and when to erase the data.' and 'Erase stored data by `dataEraseAt`.'
